_comment: How the three contact writes refuse a caller that lacks their permission (design D1, D2, D7). Written 2026-11-05 from Platform main a1fc0481 by reading the code; nothing here was run. The permission is evaluated IN THE HANDLER, first, through IAuthorizationService with the policy `Permission:<id>` (the SupervisorListenEndpoints pattern), so the refusal carries the existing ErrorResponse body (Endpoints/Shared/ErrorResponse.cs: `{"error": <code>}`) and never a bare policy 403 or server prose (Verbara.Platform.Web/ADR-0013). ONE code for every contact-write refusal: `not-permitted` (the code SupervisorListenRefusal.NotPermitted already puts on the wire). It is answered before the body is validated and before the contact is looked up, so a refused caller learns neither whether the id exists nor whether its body was valid, and nothing is written. The Admin and SystemAdmin role claims pass every permission (PermissionAuthorizationHandler.cs:32), so a management key and a key bound to an Admin user are never refused. A tenant API key bound to no user resolves no role and is refused on all three (Platform/ADR-0047, consequences). The reads (GET /contacts, GET /contacts/{id}) are unchanged and keep `Authenticated`. ApiJsonContext: camelCase, enums as PascalCase strings, null members absent. Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names and codes VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).

permissionByRoute._covers: every member of the body, `doNotContact` and `channelConsent` included (design D3)

evaluationOrder: 2. body validation -> 400 reserved-contact-address (POST, PUT) or 400 unknown-consent-channel (PUT)
3. PUT only: no contact of the tenant has that id -> 404, no body

refusals.case: a user whose roles hold no contacts:contact:create (for example the agent template) creates a contact
a user whose roles hold no contacts:contact:edit (for example the agent template) sets do-not-contact
the same caller, on an id no contact of the tenant has: still 403, the permission runs before the lookup
a user whose roles hold no contacts:contact:delete (every seeded template except the admin family, design D4) deletes a contact
a tenant API key bound to no user, on any of the three writes

headers.Authorization: Bearer <tenant key bound to no user>

refusals._auth: the key travels as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, the only header the API-key scheme reads (ApiKeyAuthenticationHandler.cs:38 and TryReadBearerCredential at 130-142; AuthSchemeConfiguration.cs:42 forwards a request to that scheme). Nothing inbound reads `X-Api-Key`: a request carrying only that header is unauthenticated (401), never this 403. The regression uses the real authentication handler with a valid tenant key bound to no user (spec audit 2026-11-05, F2)

allowed.case: a caller holding contacts:contact:delete deletes a contact; unchanged answer, with or without a contact of that id
